card.name: Linking words in hair-loss dosing text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (with, to, comma, open parenthesis) inside dosing and contraindication sentences, mostly for finasteride, baricitinib-type hair-loss drugs and topical products. Also fires inside the brand name Taclonex.
